metadata.title: Secure Network Relying System SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan template for systems and platforms that rely on Secure Network services for connectivity, isolation, and protection.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, and assurance baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: System or platform that consumes Secure Network services for protected connectivity, segmentation, and policy enforcement without implementing network controls directly.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on the Secure Network Platform SSPP as the Tier-0 network governance and assurance anchor.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on Secure Network Gateways for mediated ingress, egress, and inter-zone traffic control.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system consumes identity assurance signals that may influence network access outcomes.

props.name: network-consumption-model
props.remarks: Network protection is inherited from Secure Network services rather than implemented locally within the system.

props.name: trust-boundary
props.remarks: Network trust decisions, segmentation, and enforcement occur outside the relying system.

props.name: authorization-separation
props.remarks: Authorization logic remains local to the system and is not delegated to network services.

props.name: resiliency-dependence
props.remarks: Network resiliency characteristics are inherited from the Secure Network Platform and Network Resiliency patterns.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: The relying system operates within a Zero Trust Architecture by consuming network protections without assuming implicit trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Identity-aware, policy-driven Secure Network services provide networking protections consumed by the relying system.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP documents reliance on Secure Network capabilities and does not implement network security controls directly.

components.title: Network-Reliant System Component
components.description: Logical representation of a system component that depends on Secure Network services for connectivity and protection.

roles.title: System Owner
roles.remarks: Defines network reliance expectations and acceptable risk for the system.

roles.title: Network Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Ensures relying systems correctly consume Secure Network protections.

control-implementation.remarks: All network security controls are inherited from Secure Network Platform and Gateway SSPPs. This SSPP documents reliance and assurance only.
